//: SPARDA x Claude Code — prove what the AI just wrote, every turn. Merge this into your project's .claude/settings.json (or copy the hook block). It runs `sparda review` after each Claude Code turn and prints the behavior diff of the changes to the transcript. Requires `sparda-mcp` installed in the project (npm i -D sparda-mcp) and this repo's sparda-prove.mjs copied to .claude/sparda-prove.mjs. The hook never blocks the loop and always exits 0.
